2.en: You can link your bank account to the app.
2.zh: 你可以把银行账户关联到这个应用。

4.en: Please give me a coherent plan, step by step.
4.zh: 请给我一个有条理的计划，一步一步说明。

9.en: The new library integrates books, music, and video in one app.
9.zh: 这个新图书馆应用把书籍、音乐和视频整合在一起。

11.en: The app gives you tangible proof of your progress.
11.zh: 这个应用会给你进步的切实证明。

13.en: Keep the receipt intact in case you need to return the item.
13.zh: 把收据保持完好，以备退货时使用。

14.en: Attach the photo to your message before you send it.
14.zh: 发送前把照片附在消息里。

17.en: Stick with the plan for one more week.

23.en: The clue was hidden in the last line of the email.
23.zh: 线索藏在邮件的最后一行。

25.en: Can you recommend a good password manager?
25.zh: 你能推荐一款好用的密码管理器吗？

26.en: The red warning light suggests that the battery is low.
26.zh: 红色警示灯表明电量不足。

40.en: This car runs on less fuel than our old one.
40.zh: 这辆车比我们的旧车更省油。

47.en: Turn off the lights to save electricity.

57.en: A small error can arise when the app is offline.
57.zh: 应用离线时可能会出现一个小错误。

60.en: You can raise the daily limit in the settings.
60.zh: 你可以在设置里调高每日限额。

65.en: We hauled the boxes up to the third floor.
65.zh: 我们把箱子费力地搬到了三楼。
